name: accessSpecDecl
summary: Matches C++ access specifier declarations.

name: addrLabelExpr
summary: Matches address of label statements (GNU extension).

name: alignOfExpr
summary: Same as unaryExprOrTypeTraitExpr, but only matching alignof.

name: allOf
summary: Matches if all given matchers match.

name: anyOf
summary: Matches if any of the given matchers matches.

name: anything
summary: Matches any node.

name: argumentCountAtLeast
summary: Checks that a call expression or a constructor call expression has at least the specified number of arguments (including absent default arguments).

name: argumentCountIs
summary: Checks that a call expression or a constructor call expression has a specific number of arguments (including absent default arguments).

name: arrayInitIndexExpr
summary: The arrayInitIndexExpr consists of two subexpressions: a common expression (the source array) that is evaluated once up-front, and a per-element initializer that runs once for each array element. Within the per-element initializer, the current index may be obtained via an ArrayInitIndexExpr.

name: arrayInitLoopExpr
summary: Matches a loop initializing the elements of an array in a number of contexts: * in the implicit copy/move constructor for a class with an array member * when a lambda-expression captures an array by value * when a decomposition declaration decomposes an array

name: arraySubscriptExpr
summary: Matches array subscript expressions.

name: arrayType
summary: Matches all kinds of arrays.

name: arrayTypeLoc
summary: Matches `ArrayTypeLoc`s.

name: asString
summary: Matches if the matched type is represented by the given string.

name: asmStmt
summary: Matches asm statements.

name: atomicExpr
summary: Matches atomic builtins. Example matches __atomic_load_n(ptr, 1) void foo() { int *ptr; __atomic_load_n(ptr, 1); }

name: atomicType
summary: Matches atomic types.

name: attr
summary: Matches attributes. Attributes may be attached with a variety of different syntaxes (including keywords, C++11 attributes, GNU ``__attribute``` and MSVC `__declspec``, and ``#pragma``s). They may also be implicit.

name: autoType
summary: Matches types nodes representing C++11 auto types.

name: autoreleasePoolStmt
summary: Matches an Objective-C autorelease pool statement.

name: binaryConditionalOperator
summary: Matches binary conditional operator expressions (GNU extension).

name: binaryOperation
summary: Matches nodes which can be used with binary operators.

name: binaryOperator
summary: Matches binary operator expressions.

name: bindingDecl
summary: Matches binding declarations Example matches foo and bar (matcher = bindingDecl()

name: blockDecl
summary: Matches block declarations.

name: blockExpr
summary: Matches a reference to a block.

name: blockPointerType
summary: Matches block pointer types, i.e. types syntactically represented as "void (^)(int)".

name: booleanType
summary: Matches type bool.

name: breakStmt
summary: Matches break statements.

name: builtinType
summary: Matches builtin Types.

name: cStyleCastExpr
summary: Matches a C-style cast expression.

name: callExpr
summary: Matches call expressions.

name: callee
summary: Matches if the call or fold expression's callee expression matches.

name: capturesThis
summary: Matches a `LambdaCapture` that refers to 'this'.

name: capturesVar
summary: Matches a `LambdaCapture` that refers to the specified `VarDecl`. The `VarDecl` can be a separate variable that is captured by value or reference, or a synthesized variable if the capture has an initializer.

name: caseStmt
summary: Matches case statements inside switch statements.

name: castExpr
summary: Matches any cast nodes of Clang's AST.

name: characterLiteral
summary: Matches character literals (also matches wchar_t).

name: chooseExpr
summary: Matches GNU __builtin_choose_expr.

name: classTemplateDecl
summary: Matches C++ class template declarations.

name: classTemplatePartialSpecializationDecl
summary: Matches C++ class template partial specializations.

name: classTemplateSpecializationDecl
summary: Matches C++ class template specializations.

name: coawaitExpr
summary: Matches co_await expressions.

name: complexType
summary: Matches C99 complex types.

name: compoundLiteralExpr
summary: Matches compound (i.e. non-scalar) literals

name: compoundStmt
summary: Matches compound statements.

name: conceptDecl
summary: Matches concept declarations.

name: conditionalOperator
summary: Matches conditional operator expressions.

name: constantArrayType
summary: Matches C arrays with a specified constant size.

name: constantExpr
summary: Matches a constant expression wrapper.

name: containsDeclaration
summary: Matches the n'th declaration of a declaration statement.

name: continueStmt
summary: Matches continue statements.

name: convertVectorExpr
summary: Matches builtin function __builtin_convertvector.

name: coreturnStmt
summary: Matches co_return statements.

name: coroutineBodyStmt
summary: Matches coroutine body statements.

name: coyieldExpr
summary: Matches co_yield expressions.

name: cudaKernelCallExpr
summary: Matches CUDA kernel call expression.

name: cxxBaseSpecifier
summary: Matches class bases.

name: cxxBindTemporaryExpr
summary: Matches nodes where temporaries are created.

name: cxxBoolLiteral
summary: Matches bool literals.

name: cxxCatchStmt
summary: Matches catch statements.

name: cxxConstCastExpr
summary: Matches a const_cast expression.

name: cxxConstructExpr
summary: Matches constructor call expressions (including implicit ones).

name: cxxConstructorDecl
summary: Matches C++ constructor declarations.

name: cxxConversionDecl
summary: Matches conversion operator declarations.

name: cxxCtorInitializer
summary: Matches constructor initializers.

name: cxxDeductionGuideDecl
summary: Matches user-defined and implicitly generated deduction guide.

name: cxxDefaultArgExpr
summary: Matches the value of a default argument at the call site.

name: cxxDeleteExpr
summary: Matches delete expressions.

name: cxxDependentScopeMemberExpr
summary: Matches member expressions where the actual member referenced could not be resolved because the base expression or the member name was dependent.

name: cxxDestructorDecl
summary: Matches explicit C++ destructor declarations.

name: cxxDynamicCastExpr
summary: Matches a dynamic_cast expression.

name: cxxFoldExpr
summary: Matches C++17 fold expressions.

name: cxxForRangeStmt
summary: Matches range-based for statements.

name: cxxFunctionalCastExpr
summary: Matches functional cast expressions

name: cxxMemberCallExpr
summary: Matches member call expressions.

name: cxxMethodDecl
summary: Matches method declarations.

name: cxxNewExpr
summary: Matches new expressions.

name: cxxNoexceptExpr
summary: Matches noexcept expressions.

name: cxxNullPtrLiteralExpr
summary: Matches nullptr literal.

name: cxxOperatorCallExpr
summary: Matches overloaded operator calls.

name: cxxRecordDecl
summary: Matches C++ class declarations.

name: cxxReinterpretCastExpr
summary: Matches a reinterpret_cast expression.

name: cxxRewrittenBinaryOperator
summary: Matches rewritten binary operators

name: cxxStaticCastExpr
summary: Matches a C++ static_cast expression.

name: cxxStdInitializerListExpr
summary: Matches C++ initializer list expressions.

name: cxxTemporaryObjectExpr
summary: Matches functional cast expressions having N != 1 arguments

name: cxxThisExpr
summary: Matches implicit and explicit this expressions.

name: cxxThrowExpr
summary: Matches throw expressions.

name: cxxTryStmt
summary: Matches try statements.

name: cxxUnresolvedConstructExpr
summary: Matches unresolved constructor call expressions.

name: decayedType
summary: Matches decayed type Example matches i[] in declaration of f. (matcher = valueDecl(hasType(decayedType(hasDecayedType(pointerType()))))) Example matches i[1]. (matcher = expr(hasType(decayedType(hasDecayedType(pointerType()))))) void f(int i[]) { i[1] = 0; }

name: decl
summary: Matches declarations.

name: declCountIs
summary: Matches declaration statements that contain a specific number of declarations.

name: declRefExpr
summary: Matches expressions that refer to declarations.

name: declStmt
summary: Matches declaration statements.

name: declaratorDecl
summary: Matches declarator declarations (field, variable, function and non-type template parameter declarations).

name: declaresSameEntityAsBoundNode
summary: Matches a declaration if it declares the same entity as the node previously bound to ID.

name: decltypeType
summary: Matches types nodes representing C++11 decltype(<expr>) types.

name: decompositionDecl
summary: Matches decomposition-declarations.

name: deducedTemplateSpecializationType
summary: Matches C++17 deduced template specialization types, e.g. deduced class template types.

name: defaultStmt
summary: Matches default statements inside switch statements.

name: dependentCoawaitExpr
summary: Matches co_await expressions where the type of the promise is dependent

name: dependentNameType
summary: Matches a dependent name type

name: dependentScopeDeclRefExpr
summary: Matches expressions that refer to dependent scope declarations.

name: dependentSizedArrayType
summary: Matches C++ arrays whose size is a value-dependent expression.

name: dependentSizedExtVectorType
summary: Matches C++ extended vector type where either the type or size is dependent.

name: designatedInitExpr
summary: Matches C99 designated initializer expressions [C99 6.7.8].

name: designatorCountIs
summary: Matches designated initializer expressions that contain a specific number of designators.

name: doStmt
summary: Matches do statements.

name: eachOf
summary: Matches if any of the given matchers matches.

name: enumConstantDecl
summary: Matches enum constants.

name: enumDecl
summary: Matches enum declarations.

name: enumType
summary: Matches enum types.

name: equals
summary: Matches literals that are equal to the given value of type ValueT.

name: equalsBoundNode
summary: Matches if a node equals a previously bound node.

name: equalsIntegralValue
summary: Matches a TemplateArgument of integral type with a given value.

name: explicitCastExpr
summary: Matches explicit cast expressions.

name: exportDecl
summary: Matches any export declaration.

name: expr
summary: Matches expressions.

name: exprWithCleanups
summary: Matches expressions that introduce cleanups to be run at the end of the sub-expression's evaluation.

name: fieldDecl
summary: Matches field declarations.

name: fileScopeAsmDecl
summary: Matches top level asm declarations.

name: fixedPointLiteral
summary: Matches fixed-point literals eg. 0.5r, 0.5hr, 0.5lr, 0.5uhr, 0.5ur, 0.5ulr 1.0k, 1.0hk, 1.0lk, 1.0uhk, 1.0uk, 1.0ulk Exponents 1.0e10k Hexadecimal numbers 0x0.2p2r

name: floatLiteral
summary: Matches float literals of all sizes / encodings, e.g. 1.0, 1.0f, 1.0L and 1e10.

name: forCallable
summary: Matches declaration of the function, method, or block the statement belongs to.

name: forDecomposition
summary: Matches the DecompositionDecl the binding belongs to.

name: forEach
summary: Matches AST nodes that have child AST nodes that match the provided matcher.

name: forEachArgumentWithParam
summary: Matches all arguments and their respective ParmVarDecl.

name: forEachArgumentWithParamType
summary: Matches all arguments and their respective types for a CallExpr or CXXConstructExpr. It is very similar to forEachArgumentWithParam but it works on calls through function pointers as well.

name: forEachConstructorInitializer
summary: Matches each constructor initializer in a constructor definition.

name: forEachDescendant
summary: Matches AST nodes that have descendant AST nodes that match the provided matcher.

name: forEachLambdaCapture
summary: Matches each lambda capture in a lambda expression.

name: forEachOverridden
summary: Matches each method overridden by the given method. This matcher may produce multiple matches.

name: forEachSwitchCase
summary: Matches each case or default statement belonging to the given switch statement. This matcher may produce multiple matches.

name: forEachTemplateArgument
summary: Matches templateSpecializationType, class template specialization, variable template specialization, and function template specialization nodes where the template argument matches the inner matcher. This matcher may produce multiple matches.

name: forField
summary: Matches the field declaration of a constructor initializer.

name: forFunction
summary: Matches declaration of the function the statement belongs to.

name: forStmt
summary: Matches for statements.

name: friendDecl
summary: Matches friend declarations.

name: functionDecl
summary: Matches function declarations.

name: functionProtoType
summary: Matches FunctionProtoType nodes.

name: functionTemplateDecl
summary: Matches C++ function template declarations.

name: functionType
summary: Matches FunctionType nodes.

name: genericSelectionExpr
summary: Matches C11 _Generic expression.

name: gnuNullExpr
summary: Matches GNU __null expression.

name: gotoStmt
summary: Matches goto statements.

name: has
summary: Matches AST nodes that have child AST nodes that match the provided matcher.

name: hasAncestor
summary: Matches AST nodes that have an ancestor that matches the provided matcher.

name: hasAnyArgument
summary: Matches any argument of a call expression or a constructor call expression, or an ObjC-message-send expression.

name: hasAnyBase
summary: Matches C++ classes that have a direct or indirect base matching BaseSpecMatcher.

name: hasAnyBinding
summary: Matches any binding of a DecompositionDecl.

name: hasAnyBody
summary: Matches a function declaration that has a given body present in the AST. Note that this matcher matches all the declarations of a function whose body is present in the AST.

name: hasAnyCapture
summary: Matches any capture in a lambda expression.

name: hasAnyClause
summary: Matches any clause in an OpenMP directive.

name: hasAnyConstructorInitializer
summary: Matches a constructor initializer.

name: hasAnyDeclaration
summary: Matches an OverloadExpr if any of the declarations in the set of overloads matches the given matcher.

name: hasAnyName
summary: Matches NamedDecl nodes that have any of the specified names.

name: hasAnyOperatorName
summary: Matches operator expressions (binary or unary) that have any of the specified names.

name: hasAnyOverloadedOperatorName
summary: Matches overloaded operator names.

name: hasAnyParameter
summary: Matches any parameter of a function or an ObjC method declaration or a block.

name: hasAnyPlacementArg
summary: Matches any placement new expression arguments.

name: hasAnySelector
summary: Matches when at least one of the supplied string equals to the Selector.getAsString()

name: hasAnySubstatement
summary: Matches compound statements where at least one substatement matches a given matcher. Also matches StmtExprs that have CompoundStmt as children.

name: hasAnyTemplateArgument
summary: Matches templateSpecializationTypes, class template specializations, variable template specializations, and function template specializations that have at least one TemplateArgument matching the given InnerMatcher.

name: hasAnyTemplateArgumentLoc
summary: Matches template specialization `TypeLoc`s, class template specializations, variable template specializations, and function template specializations that have at least one `TemplateArgumentLoc` matching the given `InnerMatcher`.

name: hasAnyUsingShadowDecl
summary: Matches any using shadow declaration.

name: hasArgument
summary: Matches the n'th argument of a call expression or a constructor call expression.

name: hasArgumentOfType
summary: Matches unary expressions that have a specific type of argument.

name: hasArraySize
summary: Matches array new expressions with a given array size.

name: hasAttr
summary: Matches declaration that has a given attribute.

name: hasAutomaticStorageDuration
summary: Matches a variable declaration that has automatic storage duration.

name: hasBase
summary: Matches the base expression of an array subscript expression.

name: hasBinding
summary: Matches the Nth binding of a DecompositionDecl.

name: hasBitWidth
summary: Matches non-static data members that are bit-fields of the specified bit width.

name: hasBody
summary: Matches a 'for', 'while', 'while' statement or a function or coroutine definition that has a given body. Note that in case of functions or coroutines this matcher only matches the definition itself and not the other declarations of the same function or coroutine.

name: hasCanonicalType
summary: Matches QualTypes whose canonical type matches InnerMatcher.

name: hasCaseConstant
summary: If the given case statement does not use the GNU case range extension, matches the constant given in the statement.

name: hasCastKind
summary: Matches casts that has a given cast kind.

name: hasCondition
summary: Matches the condition expression of an if statement, for loop, while loop, do-while loop, switch statement or conditional operator.

name: hasConditionVariableStatement
summary: Matches the condition variable statement in an if statement, for loop, while loop or switch statement.

name: hasDecayedType
summary: Matches the decayed type, whose decayed type matches InnerMatcher

name: hasDeclContext
summary: Matches declarations whose declaration context, interpreted as a Decl, matches InnerMatcher.

name: hasDeclaration
summary: Matches a node if the declaration associated with that node matches the given matcher.

name: hasDeducedType
summary: Matches AutoType nodes where the deduced type is a specific type.

name: hasDefaultArgument
summary: Matches a declaration that has default arguments.

name: hasDefinition
summary: Matches a class declaration that is defined.

name: hasDependentName
summary: Matches the dependent name of a DependentScopeDeclRefExpr or DependentNameType

name: hasDescendant
summary: Matches AST nodes that have descendant AST nodes that match the provided matcher.

name: hasDestinationType
summary: Matches casts whose destination type matches a given matcher.

name: hasDirectBase
summary: Matches C++ classes that have a direct base matching BaseSpecMatcher.

name: hasDynamicExceptionSpec
summary: Matches functions that have a dynamic exception specification.

name: hasEitherOperand
summary: Matches if either the left hand side or the right hand side of a binary operator or fold expression matches.

name: hasElementType
summary: Matches arrays and C99 complex types that have a specific element type.

name: hasElse
summary: Matches the else-statement of an if statement.

name: hasExplicitSpecifier
summary: Matches the expression in an explicit specifier if present in the given declaration.

name: hasExternalFormalLinkage
summary: Matches a declaration that has external formal linkage.

name: hasFalseExpression
summary: Matches the false branch expression of a conditional operator (binary or ternary).

name: hasFoldInit
summary: Matches the operand that does not contain the parameter pack.

name: hasGlobalStorage
summary: Matches a variable declaration that does not have local storage.

name: hasImplicitDestinationType
summary: Matches implicit casts whose destination type matches a given matcher.

name: hasInClassInitializer
summary: Matches non-static data members that have an in-class initializer.

name: hasIncrement
summary: Matches the increment statement of a for loop.

name: hasIndex
summary: Matches the index expression of an array subscript expression.

name: hasInit
summary: Matches the n'th item of an initializer list expression.

name: hasInitStatement
summary: Matches selection statements with initializer.

name: hasInitializer
summary: Matches a variable declaration that has an initializer expression that matches the given matcher.

name: hasKeywordSelector
summary: Matches when the selector is a keyword selector

name: hasLHS
summary: Matches the left hand side of binary operator expressions.

name: hasLocalQualifiers
summary: Matches QualType nodes that have local CV-qualifiers attached to the node, not hidden within a typedef.

name: hasLocalStorage
summary: Matches a variable declaration that has function scope and is a non-static local variable.

name: hasLoopInit
summary: Matches the initialization statement of a for loop.

name: hasLoopVariable
summary: Matches the initialization statement of a for loop.

name: hasMemberName
summary: Matches template-dependent, but known, member names.

name: hasMethod
summary: Matches the first method of a class or struct that satisfies InnerMatcher.

name: hasName
summary: Matches NamedDecl nodes that have the specified name.

name: hasNullSelector
summary: Matches when the selector is the empty selector

name: hasObjectExpression
summary: Matches a member expression where the object expression is matched by a given matcher. Implicit object expressions are included; that is, it matches use of implicit `this`.

name: hasOperands
summary: Matches if both matchers match with opposite sides of the binary operator or fold expression.

name: hasOperatorName
summary: Matches the operator Name of operator expressions and fold expressions (binary or unary).

name: hasOverloadedOperatorName
summary: Matches overloaded operator names.

name: hasParameter
summary: Matches the n'th parameter of a function or an ObjC method declaration or a block.

name: hasParent
summary: Matches AST nodes that have a parent that matches the provided matcher.

name: hasPattern
summary: Matches the operand that contains the parameter pack.

name: hasPlacementArg
summary: Matches placement new expression arguments.

name: hasPointeeLoc
summary: Matches pointer `TypeLoc`s that have a pointee `TypeLoc` matching `PointeeMatcher`.

name: hasPrefix
summary: Matches on the prefix of a NestedNameSpecifierLoc.

name: hasQualifier
summary: Matches Types whose qualifier, a NestedNameSpecifier, matches InnerMatcher if the qualifier exists.

name: hasRHS
summary: Matches the right hand side of binary operator expressions.

name: hasRangeInit
summary: Matches the range initialization statement of a for loop.

name: hasReceiver
summary: Matches if the Objective-C message is sent to an instance, and the inner matcher matches on that instance.

name: hasReceiverType
summary: Matches on the receiver of an ObjectiveC Message expression.

name: hasReferentLoc
summary: Matches reference `TypeLoc`s that have a referent `TypeLoc` matching `ReferentMatcher`.

name: hasReplacementType
summary: Matches template type parameter substitutions that have a replacement type that matches the provided matcher.

name: hasReturnTypeLoc
summary: Matches a function declared with the specified return `TypeLoc`.

name: hasReturnValue
summary: Matches the return value expression of a return statement

name: hasSelector
summary: Matches when BaseName == Selector.getAsString()

name: hasSingleDecl
summary: Matches the Decl of a DeclStmt which has a single declaration.

name: hasSize
summary: Matches nodes that have the specified size.

name: hasSizeExpr
summary: Matches VariableArrayType nodes that have a specific size expression.

name: hasSourceExpression
summary: Matches if the cast's source expression or opaque value's source expression matches the given matcher.

name: hasSpecializedTemplate
summary: Matches the specialized template of a specialization declaration.

name: hasStaticStorageDuration
summary: Matches a variable declaration that has static storage duration. It includes the variable declared at namespace scope and those declared with "static" and "extern" storage class specifiers.

name: hasStructuredBlock
summary: Matches the structured-block of the OpenMP executable directive

name: hasSyntacticForm
summary: Matches the syntactic form of init list expressions (if expression have it).

name: hasTargetDecl
summary: Matches a using shadow declaration where the target declaration is matched by the given matcher.

name: hasTemplateArgument
summary: Matches templateSpecializationType, class template specializations, variable template specializations, and function template specializations where the n'th TemplateArgument matches the given InnerMatcher.

name: hasTemplateArgumentLoc
summary: Matches template specialization `TypeLoc`s, class template specializations, variable template specializations, and function template specializations where the n'th `TemplateArgumentLoc` matches the given `InnerMatcher`.

name: hasThen
summary: Matches the then-statement of an if statement.

name: hasThreadStorageDuration
summary: Matches a variable declaration that has thread storage duration.

name: hasTrailingReturn
summary: Matches a function declared with a trailing return type.

name: hasTrueExpression
summary: Matches the true branch expression of a conditional operator.

name: hasType
summary: Overloaded to match the declaration of the expression's or value declaration's type.

name: hasTypeLoc
summary: Matches if the type location of a node matches the inner matcher.

name: hasUnaryOperand
summary: Matches if the operand of a unary operator matches.

name: hasUnarySelector
summary: Matches when the selector is a Unary Selector

name: hasUnderlyingDecl
summary: Matches a NamedDecl whose underlying declaration matches the given matcher.

name: hasUnderlyingType
summary: Matches QualType nodes to find the underlying type.

name: hasUnqualifiedDesugaredType
summary: Matches if the matched type matches the unqualified desugared type of the matched node.

name: hasUnqualifiedLoc
summary: Matches `QualifiedTypeLoc`s that have an unqualified `TypeLoc` matching `InnerMatcher`.

name: hasValueType
summary: Matches atomic types with a specific value type.

name: ifStmt
summary: Matches if statements.

name: ignoringElidableConstructorCall
summary: Matches expressions that match InnerMatcher that are possibly wrapped in an elidable constructor and other corresponding bookkeeping nodes.

name: ignoringImpCasts
summary: Matches expressions that match InnerMatcher after any implicit casts are stripped off.

name: ignoringImplicit
summary: Matches expressions that match InnerMatcher after any implicit AST nodes are stripped off.

name: ignoringParenCasts
summary: Matches expressions that match InnerMatcher after parentheses and casts are stripped off.

name: ignoringParenImpCasts
summary: Matches expressions that match InnerMatcher after implicit casts and parentheses are stripped off.

name: ignoringParens
summary: Overload ignoringParens for Expr.

name: imaginaryLiteral
summary: Matches imaginary literals, which are based on integer and floating point literals e.g.: 1i, 1.0i

name: implicitCastExpr
summary: Matches the implicit cast nodes of Clang's AST.

name: implicitValueInitExpr
summary: Matches implicit initializers of init list expressions.

name: incompleteArrayType
summary: Matches C arrays with unspecified size.

name: indirectFieldDecl
summary: Matches indirect field declarations.

name: initListExpr
summary: Matches init list expressions.

name: injectedClassNameType
summary: Matches injected class name types.

name: innerType
summary: Matches ParenType nodes where the inner type is a specific type.

name: integerLiteral
summary: Matches integer literals of all sizes / encodings, e.g. 1, 1L, 0x1 and 1U.

name: invocation
summary: Matches function calls and constructor calls

name: isAllowedToContainClauseKind
summary: Matches if the OpenMP directive is allowed to contain the specified OpenMP clause kind.

name: isAnonymous
summary: Matches anonymous namespace declarations.

name: isAnyCharacter
summary: Matches QualType nodes that are of character type.

name: isAnyPointer
summary: Matches QualType nodes that are of any pointer type; this includes the Objective-C object pointer type, which is different despite being syntactically similar.

name: isArray
summary: Matches array new expressions.

name: isArrow
summary: Matches member expressions that are called with '->' as opposed to '.'.

name: isAssignmentOperator
summary: Matches all kinds of assignment operators.

name: isAtPosition
summary: Matches the ParmVarDecl nodes that are at the N'th position in the parameter list. The parameter list could be that of either a block, function, or objc-method.

name: isBaseInitializer
summary: Matches a constructor initializer if it is initializing a base, as opposed to a member.

name: isBinaryFold
summary: Matches binary fold expressions, i.e. fold expressions with an initializer.

name: isBitField
summary: Matches non-static data members that are bit-fields.

name: isCatchAll
summary: Matches a C++ catch statement that has a catch-all handler.

name: isClass
summary: Matches TagDecl object that are spelled with "class."

name: isClassMessage
summary: Returns true when the Objective-C message is sent to a class.

name: isClassMethod
summary: Returns true when the Objective-C method declaration is a class method.

name: isComparisonOperator
summary: Matches comparison operators.

name: isConst
summary: Matches if the given method declaration is const.

name: isConstQualified
summary: Matches QualType nodes that are const-qualified, i.e., that include "top-level" const.

name: isConsteval
summary: Matches consteval function declarations and if consteval/if ! consteval statements.

name: isConstexpr
summary: Matches constexpr variable and function declarations, and if constexpr.

name: isConstinit
summary: Matches constinit variable declarations.

name: isCopyAssignmentOperator
summary: Matches if the given method declaration declares a copy assignment operator.

name: isCopyConstructor
summary: Matches constructor declarations that are copy constructors.

name: isDefaultConstructor
summary: Matches constructor declarations that are default constructors.

name: isDefaulted
summary: Matches defaulted function declarations.

name: isDefinition
summary: Matches if a declaration has a body attached.

name: isDelegatingConstructor
summary: Matches constructors that delegate to another constructor.

name: isDeleted
summary: Matches deleted function declarations.

name: isDerivedFrom
summary: Overloaded method as shortcut for isDerivedFrom(hasName(...)).

name: isDirectlyDerivedFrom
summary: Overloaded method as shortcut for isDirectlyDerivedFrom(hasName(...)).

name: isEnum
summary: Matches TagDecl object that are spelled with "enum."

name: isExceptionVariable
summary: Matches a variable declaration that is an exception variable from a C++ catch block, or an Objective-C statement.

name: isExpandedFromMacro
summary: Matches statements that are (transitively) expanded from the named macro. Does not match if only part of the statement is expanded from that macro or if different parts of the statement are expanded from different appearances of the macro.

name: isExpansionInFileMatching
summary: Matches AST nodes that were expanded within files whose name is partially matching a given regex.
signatures: Matcher<Decl> isExpansionInFileMatching(StringRef RegExp, Regex::RegexFlags Flags = NoFlags)
Matcher<Stmt> isExpansionInFileMatching(StringRef RegExp, Regex::RegexFlags Flags = NoFlags)
Matcher<TypeLoc> isExpansionInFileMatching(StringRef RegExp, Regex::RegexFlags Flags = NoFlags)

name: isExpansionInMainFile
summary: Matches AST nodes that were expanded within the main-file.

name: isExpansionInSystemHeader
summary: Matches AST nodes that were expanded within system-header-files.

name: isExplicit
summary: Matches constructor, conversion function, and deduction guide declarations that have an explicit specifier if this explicit specifier is resolved to true.

name: isExplicitObjectMemberFunction
summary: Matches if the given method declaration declares a member function with an explicit object parameter.

name: isExplicitTemplateSpecialization
summary: Matches explicit template specializations of function, class, or static member variable template instantiations.

name: isExpr
summary: Matches a sugar TemplateArgument that refers to a certain expression.

name: isExternC
summary: Matches extern "C" function or variable declarations.

name: isFinal
summary: Matches if the given method or class declaration is final.

name: isFirstPrivateKind
summary: Matches if the OpenMP ``default`` clause has ``firstprivate`` kind specified.

name: isImplicit
summary: Matches an entity that has been implicitly added by the compiler (e.g. implicit default/copy constructors).

name: isInAnonymousNamespace
summary: Matches declarations in an anonymous namespace.

name: isInStdNamespace
summary: Matches declarations in the namespace `std`, but not in nested namespaces.

name: isInTemplateInstantiation
summary: Matches statements inside of a template instantiation.

name: isInitCapture
summary: Matches a variable serving as the implicit variable for a lambda init- capture.

name: isInline
summary: Matches functions, variables and namespace declarations that are marked with the inline keyword.

name: isInstanceMessage
summary: Returns true when the Objective-C message is sent to an instance.

name: isInstanceMethod
summary: Returns true when the Objective-C method declaration is an instance method.

name: isInstantiated
summary: Matches declarations that are template instantiations or are inside template instantiations.

name: isInstantiationDependent
summary: Matches expressions that are instantiation-dependent even if it is neither type- nor value-dependent.

name: isInteger
summary: Matches QualType nodes that are of integer type.

name: isIntegral
summary: Matches a TemplateArgument that is an integral value.

name: isLambda
summary: Matches the generated class of lambda expressions.

name: isLeftFold
summary: Matches left-folding fold expressions.

name: isListInitialization
summary: Matches a constructor call expression which uses list initialization.

name: isMain
summary: Determines whether the function is "main", which is the entry point into an executable program.

name: isMemberInitializer
summary: Matches a constructor initializer if it is initializing a member, as opposed to a base.

name: isMoveAssignmentOperator
summary: Matches if the given method declaration declares a move assignment operator.

name: isMoveConstructor
summary: Matches constructor declarations that are move constructors.

name: isNoReturn
summary: Matches FunctionDecls that have a noreturn attribute.

name: isNoThrow
summary: Matches functions that have a non-throwing exception specification.

name: isNoneKind
summary: Matches if the OpenMP ``default`` clause has ``none`` kind specified.

name: isOverride
summary: Matches if the given method declaration overrides another method.

name: isPrivate
summary: Matches private C++ declarations and C++ base specifiers that specify private inheritance.

name: isPrivateKind
summary: Matches if the OpenMP ``default`` clause has ``private`` kind specified.

name: isProtected
summary: Matches protected C++ declarations and C++ base specifiers that specify protected inheritance.

name: isPublic
summary: Matches public C++ declarations and C++ base specifiers that specify public inheritance.

name: isPure
summary: Matches if the given method declaration is pure.

name: isRightFold
summary: Matches right-folding fold expressions.

name: isSameOrDerivedFrom
summary: Overloaded method as shortcut for isSameOrDerivedFrom(hasName(...)).

name: isScoped
summary: Matches C++11 scoped enum declaration.

name: isSharedKind
summary: Matches if the OpenMP ``default`` clause has ``shared`` kind specified.

name: isSignedInteger
summary: Matches QualType nodes that are of signed integer type.

name: isStandaloneDirective
summary: Matches standalone OpenMP directives, i.e., directives that can't have a structured block.

name: isStaticLocal
summary: Matches a static variable with local scope.

name: isStaticStorageClass
summary: Matches variable/function declarations that have "static" storage class specifier ("static" keyword) written in the source.

name: isStruct
summary: Matches TagDecl object that are spelled with "struct."

name: isTemplateInstantiation
summary: Matches template instantiations of function, class, or static member variable template instantiations.

name: isTypeDependent
summary: Matches expressions that are type-dependent because the template type is not yet instantiated.

name: isUnaryFold
summary: Matches unary fold expressions, i.e. fold expressions without an initializer.

name: isUnion
summary: Matches TagDecl object that are spelled with "union."

name: isUnsignedInteger
summary: Matches QualType nodes that are of unsigned integer type.

name: isUserProvided
summary: Matches method declarations that are user-provided.

name: isValueDependent
summary: Matches expression that are value-dependent because they contain a non-type template parameter.

name: isVariadic
summary: Matches if a function declaration is variadic.

name: isVirtual
summary: Matches declarations of virtual methods and C++ base specifiers that specify virtual inheritance.

name: isVirtualAsWritten
summary: Matches if the given method declaration has an explicit "virtual".

name: isVolatileQualified
summary: Matches QualType nodes that are volatile-qualified, i.e., that include "top-level" volatile.

name: isWeak
summary: Matches weak function declarations.

name: isWritten
summary: Matches a constructor initializer if it is explicitly written in code (as opposed to implicitly added by the compiler).

name: lValueReferenceType
summary: Matches lvalue reference types.

name: labelDecl
summary: Matches a declaration of label.

name: labelStmt
summary: Matches label statements.

name: lambdaCapture
summary: Matches lambda captures.

name: lambdaExpr
summary: Matches lambda expressions.

name: linkageSpecDecl
summary: Matches a declaration of a linkage specification.

name: loc
summary: Matches NestedNameSpecifierLocs for which the given inner NestedNameSpecifier-matcher matches.

name: macroQualifiedType
summary: Matches qualified types when the qualifier is applied via a macro.

name: mapAnyOf
summary: Matches any of the NodeMatchers with InnerMatchers nested within

name: matchesName
summary: Matches NamedDecl nodes whose fully qualified names contain a substring matched by the given RegExp.
signatures: Matcher<NamedDecl> matchesName(StringRef RegExp, Regex::RegexFlags Flags = NoFlags)

name: matchesSelector
summary: Matches ObjC selectors whose name contains a substring matched by the given RegExp. matcher = objCMessageExpr(matchesSelector("loadHTMLStringmatches the outer message expr in the code below, but NOT the message invocation for self.bodyView. [self.bodyView loadHTMLString:html baseURL:NULL];
signatures: Matcher<ObjCMessageExpr> matchesSelector(StringRef RegExp, Regex::RegexFlags Flags = NoFlags)

name: materializeTemporaryExpr
summary: Matches nodes where temporaries are materialized.

name: member
summary: Matches a member expression where the member is matched by a given matcher.

name: memberExpr
summary: Matches member expressions.

name: memberHasSameNameAsBoundNode
summary: Matches template-dependent, but known, member names against an already-bound node

name: memberPointerType
summary: Matches member pointer types. Given struct A { int i; } A::* ptr = A::i; memberPointerType() matches "A::* ptr"

name: namedDecl
summary: Matches a declaration of anything that could have a name.

name: namespaceAliasDecl
summary: Matches a declaration of a namespace alias.

name: namespaceDecl
summary: Matches a declaration of a namespace.

name: nestedNameSpecifier
summary: Matches nested name specifiers.

name: nestedNameSpecifierLoc
summary: Same as nestedNameSpecifier but matches NestedNameSpecifierLoc.

name: nonTypeTemplateParmDecl
summary: Matches non-type template parameter declarations.

name: nullPointerConstant
summary: Matches expressions that resolve to a null pointer constant, such as GNU's __null, C++11's nullptr, or C's NULL macro.

name: nullStmt
summary: Matches null statements.

name: numSelectorArgs
summary: Matches when the selector has the specified number of arguments

name: objcCatchStmt
summary: Matches Objective-C @catch statements.

name: objcCategoryDecl
summary: Matches Objective-C category declarations.

name: objcCategoryImplDecl
summary: Matches Objective-C category definitions.

name: objcFinallyStmt
summary: Matches Objective-C @finally statements.

name: objcImplementationDecl
summary: Matches Objective-C implementation declarations.

name: objcInterfaceDecl
summary: Matches Objective-C interface declarations.

name: objcIvarDecl
summary: Matches Objective-C instance variable declarations.

name: objcIvarRefExpr
summary: Matches a reference to an ObjCIvar.

name: objcMessageExpr
summary: Matches ObjectiveC Message invocation expressions.

name: objcMethodDecl
summary: Matches Objective-C method declarations.

name: objcObjectPointerType
summary: Matches an Objective-C object pointer type, which is different from a pointer type, despite being syntactically similar.

name: objcPropertyDecl
summary: Matches Objective-C property declarations.

name: objcProtocolDecl
summary: Matches Objective-C protocol declarations.

name: objcStringLiteral
summary: Matches ObjectiveC String literal expressions.

name: objcThrowStmt
summary: Matches Objective-C statements.

name: objcTryStmt
summary: Matches Objective-C @try statements.

name: ofClass
summary: Matches the class declaration that the given method declaration belongs to.

name: ofKind
summary: Matches unary expressions of a certain kind.

name: ompDefaultClause
summary: Matches OpenMP ``default`` clause.

name: ompExecutableDirective
summary: Matches any ``#pragma omp`` executable directive.

name: on
summary: Matches on the implicit object argument of a member call expression, after stripping off any parentheses or implicit casts.

name: onImplicitObjectArgument
summary: Matches on the implicit object argument of a member call expression. Unlike `on`, matches the argument directly without stripping away anything.

name: opaqueValueExpr
summary: Matches opaque value expressions. They are used as helpers to reference another expressions and can be met in BinaryConditionalOperators, for example.

name: optionally
summary: Matches any node regardless of the submatcher.

name: parameterCountIs
summary: Matches FunctionDecls and FunctionProtoTypes that have a specific parameter count.

name: parenExpr
summary: Matches parentheses used in expressions.

name: parenListExpr
summary: Matches paren list expressions. ParenListExprs don't have a predefined type and are used for late parsing. In the final AST, they can be met in template declarations.

name: parenType
summary: Matches ParenType nodes.

name: parmVarDecl
summary: Matches parameter variable declarations.

name: pointee
summary: Narrows PointerType (and similar) matchers to those where the pointee matches a given matcher.

name: pointerType
summary: Matches pointer types, but does not match Objective-C object pointer types.

name: pointerTypeLoc
summary: Matches pointer `TypeLoc`s.

name: pointsTo
summary: Overloaded to match the pointee type's declaration.

name: predefinedExpr
summary: Matches predefined identifier expressions [C99 6.4.2.2].

name: qualType
summary: Matches QualTypes in the clang AST.

name: qualifiedTypeLoc
summary: Matches `QualifiedTypeLoc`s in the clang AST.

name: rValueReferenceType
summary: Matches rvalue reference types.

name: realFloatingPointType
summary: Matches any real floating-point type (float, double, long double).

name: recordDecl
summary: Matches class, struct, and union declarations.

name: recordType
summary: Matches record types (e.g. structs, classes).

name: referenceType
summary: Matches both lvalue and rvalue reference types.

name: referenceTypeLoc
summary: Matches reference `TypeLoc`s.

name: references
summary: Overloaded to match the referenced type's declaration.

name: refersToDeclaration
summary: Matches a canonical TemplateArgument that refers to a certain declaration.

name: refersToIntegralType
summary: Matches a TemplateArgument that refers to an integral type.

name: refersToTemplate
summary: Matches a TemplateArgument that refers to a certain template.

name: refersToType
summary: Matches a TemplateArgument that refers to a certain type.

name: requiresZeroInitialization
summary: Matches a constructor call expression which requires zero initialization.

name: returnStmt
summary: Matches return statements.

name: returns
summary: Matches the return type of a function declaration.

name: sizeOfExpr
summary: Same as unaryExprOrTypeTraitExpr, but only matching sizeof.

name: specifiesNamespace
summary: Matches nested name specifiers that specify a namespace matching the given namespace matcher.

name: specifiesType
summary: Matches nested name specifiers that specify a type matching the given QualType matcher without qualifiers.

name: specifiesTypeLoc
summary: Matches nested name specifier locs that specify a type matching the given TypeLoc.

name: statementCountIs
summary: Checks that a compound statement contains a specific number of child statements.

name: staticAssertDecl
summary: Matches a C++ static_assert declaration.

name: stmt
summary: Matches statements.

name: stmtExpr
summary: Matches statement expression (GNU extension).

name: stringLiteral
summary: Matches string literals (also matches wide string literals).

name: substNonTypeTemplateParmExpr
summary: Matches substitutions of non-type template parameters.

name: substTemplateTypeParmType
summary: Matches types that represent the result of substituting a type for a template type parameter.

name: switchCase
summary: Matches case and default statements inside switch statements.

name: switchStmt
summary: Matches switch statements.

name: tagDecl
summary: Matches tag declarations.

name: tagType
summary: Matches tag types (record and enum types).

name: templateArgument
summary: Matches template arguments.

name: templateArgumentCountIs
summary: Matches if the number of template arguments equals N.

name: templateArgumentLoc
summary: Matches template arguments (with location info).

name: templateName
summary: Matches template name.

name: templateSpecializationType
summary: Matches template specialization types.

name: templateSpecializationTypeLoc
summary: Matches template specialization `TypeLoc`s.

name: templateTemplateParmDecl
summary: Matches template template parameter declarations.

name: templateTypeParmDecl
summary: Matches template type parameter declarations.

name: templateTypeParmType
summary: Matches template type parameter types.

name: thisPointerType
summary: Overloaded to match the type's declaration.

name: throughUsingDecl
summary: Matches if a node refers to a declaration through a specific using shadow declaration.

name: to
summary: Matches a DeclRefExpr that refers to a declaration that matches the specified matcher.

name: translationUnitDecl
summary: Matches the top declaration context.

name: type
summary: Matches Types in the clang AST.

name: typeAliasDecl
summary: Matches type alias declarations.

name: typeAliasTemplateDecl
summary: Matches type alias template declarations.

name: typeLoc
summary: Matches TypeLocs in the clang AST.

name: typedefDecl
summary: Matches typedef declarations.

name: typedefNameDecl
summary: Matches typedef name declarations.

name: typedefType
summary: Matches typedef types.

name: unaryExprOrTypeTraitExpr
summary: Matches sizeof (C99), alignof (C++11) and vec_step (OpenCL)

name: unaryOperator
summary: Matches unary operator expressions.

name: unaryTransformType
summary: Matches types nodes representing unary type transformations.

name: unless
summary: Matches if the provided matcher does not match.

name: unresolvedLookupExpr
summary: Matches reference to a name that can be looked up during parsing but could not be resolved to a specific declaration.

name: unresolvedMemberExpr
summary: Matches unresolved member expressions.

name: unresolvedUsingTypenameDecl
summary: Matches unresolved using value declarations that involve the typename.

name: unresolvedUsingValueDecl
summary: Matches unresolved using value declarations.

name: userDefinedLiteral
summary: Matches user defined literal operator call.

name: usesADL
summary: Matches call expressions which were resolved using ADL.

name: usingDecl
summary: Matches using declarations.

name: usingDirectiveDecl
summary: Matches using namespace declarations.

name: usingEnumDecl
summary: Matches using-enum declarations.

name: usingShadowDecl
summary: Matches shadow declarations introduced into a scope by a (resolved) using declaration.

name: usingType
summary: Matches types specified through a using declaration.

name: valueDecl
summary: Matches any value declaration.

name: varDecl
summary: Matches variable declarations.

name: variableArrayType
summary: Matches C arrays with a specified size that is not an integer-constant-expression.

name: voidType
summary: Matches type void.

name: whileStmt
summary: Matches while statements.

name: withInitializer
summary: Matches the initializer expression of a constructor initializer.
